clusters.name: Building with steel for GCs
clusters.summary: Help general contractors understand how their wood-frame crews can prepare for residential cold-formed steel framing, including training, tools and site coordination.
clusters.purpose: Crew readiness can determine whether a GC considers steel at all. Practical guidance makes the transition easier to understand, addresses concerns about unfamiliar work and gives builders a reason to involve Wheeler early.
audiences: framing crews moving from wood to steel
jobs: Understand which wood-framing skills transfer and what additional training is needed
Plan the tools, crew preparation and installation sequence for a first steel-framing project
Clarify what Wheeler supplies, what the crew installs and when to involve the design team
clusters.editorialNote: We will develop practical guidance with Wheeler’s input, drawing on Don’s residential steel experience and approved project material. Cover crew adaptation, training needs, tools, site preparation and coordination. Distinguish on-site assembly of project-specific steel components from preassembled panels. Verify any available training or site support before describing it; do not imply Wheeler provides installation or a formal training program. Project-specific connections, modifications and engineering remain governed by approved documents and qualified professionals.
